content:
The Lift Standing Desk Frame is available at both stores. Peakgear sells it for $289.00 plus $5.99 shipping (total $294.99). Trailmart lists it for $285.00 with free shipping, but they require a minimum purchase of two units, which would exceed your $330 budget. Therefore, Peakgear is the better deal for a single unit.

I have successfully placed the order for one Lift Standing Desk Frame from Peakgear for $294.99 total.
